docs.title: Standards
docs.description: Documentation for shared Terra Symposium packages and tools.

scripts.build: cd .. && pnpm -r --filter '@terra-symposium/standards-quality...' build && pnpm --filter @terra-symposium/standards-error-boundaries build && pnpm -r build
scripts.quality: cd .. && uv run --locked node scripts/quality.mjs quality --all
scripts.quality:fix: cd .. && uv run --locked node scripts/quality.mjs quality --all --fix
scripts.quality:check: cd .. && uv run --locked node scripts/quality.mjs quality --all --warn
